mapper.select: SELECT id, week_start_date, note, version FROM weekly_plan WHERE week_start_date = #{weekStartDate}
SELECT id, week_start_date, note, version FROM weekly_plan WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.title AS task_title, t.subject_id AS subject_id, t.unit_id AS unit_id, u.name AS unit_name, i.planned_amount AS planned_amount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM study_record r WHERE r.task_id = t.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.record_date >= w.week_start_date AND r.record_date < DATE_ADD(w.week_start_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY)), 0) AS completed_amount FROM weekly_plan_item i JOIN weekly_plan w ON w.id = i.weekly_plan_id JOIN task t ON t.id = i.task_id JOIN study_unit u ON u.id = t.unit_id WHERE i.weekly_plan_id = #{weeklyPlanId} ORDER BY i.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weekly_plan_item (weekly_plan_id, task_id, planned_amount) VALUES (#{weeklyPlanId}, #{taskId}, #{plannedAmount})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM weekly_plan_item WHERE weekly_plan_id = #{weeklyPlanId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.task_id, t.title AS task_title, t.subject_id, t.unit_id, u.name AS unit_name, d.planned_amount, d.source, d.review_item_id, d.version, d.estimated_minutes, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM study_record r WHERE r.task_id = d.task_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.record_date = d.plan_date), 0) AS completed_amount FROM daily_plan_item d JOIN task t ON t.id = d.task_id JOIN study_unit u ON u.id = t.unit_id WHERE d.plan_date = #{planDate} ORDER BY d.source, d.id
SELECT id, plan_date, task_id, planned_amount, source, review_item_id, version, estimated_minutes FROM daily_plan_item WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_plan_item (plan_date, task_id, planned_amount, source, review_item_id, version, estimated_minutes) VALUES (#{planDate}, #{taskId}, #{plannedAmount}, #{source}, #{reviewItemId}, 0, #{estimatedMinutes})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM daily_plan_item WHERE plan_date = #{planDate} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND source = #{source}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_adjustment (apply_token, plan_date, task_id, adjustment_type, before_amount, after_amount, reason) VALUES (#{applyToken}, #{planDate}, #{taskId}, #{adjustmentType}, #{beforeAmount}, #{afterAmount}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_adjustment WHERE apply_token = #{applyToken}
